title: Card faces show what the card does
reasons:
agent asked: the agent disagrees with a finding:
# Findings not changed in code

## 19a5b74f-388e-4ee1-8eda-3b5746d0665c: Phone players cannot read card effects

The measurements in the finding are right (they are the ones recorded in
`evidence/issue21/scenes.md`). The cause is not `CARD_TEXT`, and no value of `CARD_TEXT` fixes it.

- The board is a fixed 960×540 canvas (`web/board.ts:16`) scaled to the viewport. At 375 px wide the
  scale is about 0.39, so 12 screen px of text needs about 31 board px. The smallest stone is
  104×94 board px; "Blocks 9 damage from the opposing slot only." cannot fit on it at 31 px. Raising
  `minPx` would only make the text overflow the stone.
- This was already true before this change: the stone names on the same board draw at 4.1 px on
  the phone viewport (same scene report). `factory/rule-coverage.md` (row "Text on the board is
  readable and does not collide") records it: "at 375px the board's smallest is 4.1px (line stone
  names) ... so the phone layout needs its own fix", and says the text-size report is reported
  only, not a gate.
- Hand cards, which are drawn at full size below the board on narrow screens, show 7.1 px; that
  is the same hand layout that existed before this issue.

The fix is a phone layout for the board (larger stones or a different arrangement under ~720 px),
which is a separate ticket, not a change to the card text sizes in this issue. A person should
decide whether to open it.
